Name: MENU_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Global menu and HUD settings: death screen timing, HP/FP/stamina bar lengths, key guide icons, world map cursor and travel limits, compass ranges, system announcements and auto-hide HUD thresholds. Only row 0 is used.

Fields.Name: YOU DIED - Fade Out Delay (Host)
Fields.Description: Seconds after YOU DIED appears before the screen fades out when you die as the host or in solo play. Retail: 3.8.

Fields.Name: YOU DIED - Fade Out Delay (Phantom)
Fields.Description: Seconds after the death message appears before the screen fades out when you die as a summoned or invading phantom. One of the death sequences waits twice this value plus 1.5 seconds instead. Retail: 3.3.

Fields.Name: HP Bar - Full-Length Max HP
Fields.Description: Max HP at which the HP bar reaches its full length. A lower max HP gives a proportionally shorter bar; higher values are capped at full length. Retail: 3565.

Fields.Name: FP Bar - Full-Length Max FP
Fields.Description: Max FP at which the FP bar reaches its full length. A lower max FP gives a proportionally shorter bar; higher values are capped at full length. Retail: 825.

Fields.Name: Stamina Bar - Full-Length Max Stamina
Fields.Description: Max stamina at which the stamina bar reaches its full length. A lower max stamina gives a proportionally shorter bar; higher values are capped at full length. Retail: 480.

Fields.Name: Action Panel - Max Switch Speed
Fields.Description: Metres per second. The action panel can only be switched while the player moves at or below this speed. Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: Action Panel - Speed Averaging Time
Fields.Description: Seconds over which the player's speed is averaged for Action Panel - Max Switch Speed. 0 uses the current speed. Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Vertical Offset
Fields.Description: Vertical offset in pixels of button icons inside on-screen text (key guides). Positive moves the icon up, negative down. Retail: -16.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Select Radius
Fields.Description: Pixels. A map icon within this radius of the cursor is selected. Retail: 60.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Decal Position Offset X
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: -8.

Fields.Name: Decal Position Offset Y
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 40.

Fields.Name: Target State Icon - Search Duration
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 2.

Fields.Name: Target State Icon - Battle Duration
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 2.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Speed
Fields.Description: Cursor speed in pixels per second at full stick tilt, scaled by the stick input and the current zoom level. Retail: 420.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor First Step Distance
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 35.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor First Step Delay
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0.09.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Wait Time
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0.09.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Snap Radius
Fields.Description: Pixels. The cursor snaps to a map icon that comes within this radius. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Snap Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the cursor takes to move onto the icon it snaps to. Retail: 0.09.

Fields.Name: Item Pickup Log - Display Time
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 6.

Fields.Name: Poise Bar - Full-Length Max Poise
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (there is no player poise bar). Retail: 380.

Fields.Name: World Map - Underground Layer Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be ON for the underground map to be available on the world map. -1 uses flag 0. Retail: 82001.

Fields.Name: World Map - Travelled Area Margin
Fields.Description: Metres. Each map layer keeps a travelled rectangle that grows to include the player's position plus this margin in all four directions; it sets how far the world map can be scrolled. Retail: 256.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Scroll Pause Time
Fields.Description: Seconds a long system announcement waits before and after each scroll pass. Retail: 3.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Scroll Speed
Fields.Description: Scroll speed of long system announcements in pixels per second (1920 × 1080 menu space). Retail: 150.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Short Text Display Time
Fields.Description: Seconds a short system announcement that doesn't need scrolling stays on screen. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Scroll Repeat Count
Fields.Description: Number of times a long system announcement scrolls before it fades out. Retail: 3.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Compass - Map Marker Display Distance
Fields.Description: Metres. Map markers placed by the player appear on the compass only within this distance. Retail: 50.

Fields.Name: Compass - Site of Grace Display Distance
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 50.

Fields.Name: Destination Marker - Reached Distance
Fields.Description: Metres (horizontal). A destination marker counts as reached when the player comes within this distance of it. Retail: 2.

Fields.Name: Colour Picker - Saturation/Brightness Slider Speed
Fields.Description: Percent per second the saturation and brightness sliders of the colour picker move at full stick tilt (scaled by stick input). Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: Opening Movie - Wait Time
Fields.Description: Seconds to wait before the opening movie plays. Retail: 3.5.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Scale
Fields.Description: Percent of the texture size at which button icons inside on-screen text (key guides) are drawn. 100 is the texture size. Retail: 50.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Scale (Controls List)
Fields.Description: Percent of the texture size at which button icons are drawn in the controls list. 100 is the texture size. Retail: 34.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Vertical Offset (Controls List)
Fields.Description: Vertical offset in pixels of button icons in the controls list. Positive moves the icon up, negative down. Retail: -16.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Scale (Key Config)
Fields.Description: Percent of the texture size at which button icons are drawn in the key config menu. 100 is the texture size. Retail: 47.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Vertical Offset (Key Config)
Fields.Description: Vertical offset in pixels of button icons in the key config menu. Positive moves the icon up, negative down. Retail: -16.

Fields.Name: World Map - Reveal Radius
Fields.Description: Metres. Radius around the player that is marked as visited on the world map. Retail: 320.

Fields.Name: Tutorial Popup - Display Time
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 3.

Fields.Name: Compass - Friendly Host Hide Distance
Fields.Description: Metres (horizontal). A friendly host is not shown on the compass while closer than this. 0 always shows them. Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Compass - Hostile Host Hide Distance
Fields.Description: Metres (horizontal). A hostile host (for an invader) is not shown on the compass while closer than this. 0 always shows them. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Compass - Friendly Guest Hide Distance
Fields.Description: Metres (horizontal). A friendly guest phantom is not shown on the compass while closer than this. 0 always shows them. Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Cutscene Skip Prompt - Display Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the skip prompt stays on screen after a button is pressed during a cutscene. The skip is only accepted while the prompt is shown. Retail: 5.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show HP Bar Below %
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the HP bar stays visible while HP is at or below this percent of max HP. Combined with the value threshold by OR. -1 disables. Retail: 99.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show HP Bar Below Value
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the HP bar stays visible while current HP is at or below this value. Combined with the percent threshold by OR. -1 disables. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show FP Bar Below %
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the FP bar stays visible while FP is at or below this percent of max FP. Combined with the value threshold by OR. -1 disables. Retail: 70.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show FP Bar Below Value
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the FP bar stays visible while current FP is at or below this value. Combined with the percent threshold by OR. -1 disables. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show Stamina Bar Below %
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the stamina bar stays visible while stamina is at or below this percent of max stamina. Combined with the value threshold by OR. -1 disables. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show Stamina Bar Below Value
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the stamina bar stays visible while current stamina is at or below this value. Combined with the percent threshold by OR. -1 disables. Retail: 28.

Fields.Name: World Map - Zoom Animation Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the world map zoom animation takes. Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: World Map - Minimum Icon Scale
Fields.Description: Scale of world map icons when fully zoomed out (0–1). Icons grow towards 1 as you zoom in, following the square root of the zoom progress. Retail: 0.4.

Fields.Name: World Map - Map Point Travelled Margin
Fields.Description: Metres. Margin added in all four directions when a map point (WorldMapPointParam) adds its position to the travelled rectangle, if the unlock doesn't give its own margin. Retail: 64.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Left Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or right of this X position. Retail: 130.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Right Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or left of this X position. Retail: 1790.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Top Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or below this Y position. Retail: 175.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Bottom Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or above this Y position. Retail: 990.

Fields.Name: Torrent HP Bar - Heal Display Threshold
Fields.Description: Torrent's HP bar is shown when a single heal restores more than this much HP. Retail: 5.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: World Map - DLC Map Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be ON for the Realm of Shadow map to be available on the world map. -1 uses flag 0. Retail: 82002.

Fields.Name: Map Mouse Scroll - Left Edge Area
Fields.Description: Pixels from the left screen edge where the mouse cursor scrolls the map left. Retail: 150.

Fields.Name: Map Mouse Scroll - Right Edge Area
Fields.Description: Pixels from the right screen edge where the mouse cursor scrolls the map right. Retail: 150.

Fields.Name: Map Mouse Scroll - Top Edge Area
Fields.Description: Pixels from the top screen edge where the mouse cursor scrolls the map up. Retail: 150.

Fields.Name: Map Mouse Scroll - Bottom Edge Area
Fields.Description: Pixels from the bottom screen edge where the mouse cursor scrolls the map down. Retail: 150.
Padding.
